newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-GANZ SENDS INTER THROUGH TO SEMIFINALS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GANZ SENDS INTER THROUGH TO SEMIFINALS.

text.p: Maurizio Ganz ended Belgium's interest in the European club competitions on Tuesday with the goals that sent Inter Milan into the UEFA Cup semifinals 3-2 on aggregate against Anderlecht.

Ganz had scored in the away leg in Belgium earlier in the month and the Italian added two more at the San Siro stadium as Anderlecht, the last Belgian club in the three European tournaments, were beaten 2-1 by a far from impressive Inter.
The 28-year-old striker grabbed the first in the 12th minute with a header off a cross from France's Youri Djorkaeff.

Ganz's second was also a header, a dive in the 60th minute to connect with a cross from Argentine Javier Zanetti and keep Inter on course for a third UEFA Cup in seven years. The club were champions in 1991 and 1994.

Anderlecht had equalised in the 33rd minute when Ghanaian striker Yaw Preko -- who has not scored in the Belgian league since September -- prodded in on the volley a cross from Swedish captain Par Zetterberg.

Ganz had chances to complete a hat-trick before English coach Roy Hodgson pulled him off in the 76th minute to make way for Dutchman Aron Winter, who was sent packing to the stands at the weekend in a row with the boss.
